name: ChinaDivision OrderFulfillment for WooCommerce
author: chinadivision

sections.description:
This plugin relies on the WooCommerce plugin as a third-party service and synchronizes your WooCommerce order information with ChinaDivision to assist you in shipping.

This plugin can automatically or manually sync your orders to ChinaDivision, and it also supports returning and updating your order with the ChinaDivision tracking number.

How to Install a Plugin

To install and activate your new plugin/extension:

  • Go to https://www.chinadivision.com/woocommerce-order-fulfillment download the plugin .zip file to your computer.
  • Go to: WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New to upload.
  • Click Upload Plugin at the top.
  • Click Choose File and select the .zip file you downloaded in step 1. Select Choose.
  • Click Install Now.
  • Activate the plugin.
  • Go to: WooCommerce > Order, Click the Setting button at the top.

input your ChinaDivision apikey and order prefix.

How to find ChinaDivision apikey?

You can log in to the ChinaDivision.com , click on your personal avatar in the upper right corner of the dashboard page, and find it in the settings option.

What does ‘order prefix’ mean?

If your order prefix is “CD_” and the order number is “1001”, after synchronizing to the ChinaDivision, the order number will be “CD_1001”.

ChinaDivision.com Privacy Policy

When using this plugin, your domain information will be recorded and saved through ChinaDivision’s domain https://stapi.cnstocm.com for the purpose of returning and updating your order with the ChinaDivision tracking number.

After uninstalling this plugin, the saved data will be deleted simultaneously.

Woocommerce Order information is pushed to ChinaDivision via the domain https://api.chinadivision.com. For more privacy policy information, please click: Privacy Policy
